attempts.summary: Set up HTTPS on node1:8443 via nginx with a self-signed cert that auto-renews via a busybox-crond minute-tick script (renew-cert.sh), which regenerates the cert 3 minutes before its 5-minute expiry and gracefully reloads nginx (`nginx -s reload`) so it picks up the new cert with zero dropped requests. Verified this live: a continuous curl probe showed unbroken HTTP 200s across two real automatic renewals (serial rotated at 11:57:00 and again at 11:59:00, confirmed against cert-renew.log). Then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, services, cert, HTTPS 200), issued a native `reboot`, confirmed the node dropped and later returned with a different boot_id, and verified nginx, crond, the crontab entry, the persisted cert, and HTTPS on 8443 all recovered post-restart.
